summary: Iteration 2 tested the 4 new features: smart Alerts, Monthly Summary, Investment Radar (BCB SGS + AI analyze via Emergent LLM Claude), and App Lock (PIN bcrypt + rate limit + WebAuthn options). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASSED in test_extras.py (alerts shape+ordering, summary math, BCB rates >0 with all 5 options, compound-interest simulator, AI analyze returns non-empty PT-BR text, lock setup/unlock/status/change/remove happy paths, 409 on double setup, 401 on wrong PIN, 429 after >=5 wrong PINs with locked_until, WebAuthn register options challenge). Frontend: Dashboard renders alerts-section (3 alerts) and month-summary (Entrou/Saiu/Sobrou) correctly. Radar tab was CRASHING on mount with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading source)'; root cause found (initial state loading=false + rates=null renders rates.source before useEffect fires) — FIXED in Relatorios.jsx by initializing loading=true and adding a null-guard. After fix, Radar shows all 5 options, simulator produces Você terá/Aportado/Rendimento, AI analysis returned ~2.8kB of Portuguese text. Security tab: setup PIN → reload shows full lock-screen with numeric keypad pin-0..pin-9; keypad fills PIN dots but does NOT auto-submit — user must press 'Desbloquear' button. Unlock works, and remove-pin flow works via UI. PIN removed at end (verified GET /api/lock/status → configured:false).

ui_bugs.issue: Component crashed on first mount with TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'source'). Initial state had loading=false so first render read rates.source before load() completed. FIXED by testing agent (loading initial=true + `if (!rates) return null` guard).

issues: PIN keypad does not auto-submit when 4-6 digits are entered — user must additionally press 'Desbloquear'. Consider auto-submit on reaching PIN length for better UX (similar to native OS lock screens).

action_items: Consider auto-submitting the PIN on the lock-screen when it reaches configured length instead of requiring the 'Desbloquear' button click.
(Code quality) Radar's load() sets loading=true only inside handler — safer to keep initial state loading=true (applied by test agent) so first render never reads undefined rates.
critical_code_review_comments: extras.py `_sgs` uses synchronous `requests.get` inside async endpoints — blocks the event loop for the duration of BCB HTTP call (up to 10s). Should be `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` or use httpx.AsyncClient.
extras.py rate cache `_rate_cache` is a plain module-level dict without a lock — concurrent first-hit callers may each fire BCB requests; acceptable but worth noting.

extras.py lock_unlock: locked_until only set when fails>=5, but `failed_attempts` counter is never reset after a natural window elapses (only after successful unlock). Long-lived counter could keep escalating delays for occasional wrong entries.
extras.py lock_change endpoint does NOT check `locked_until` — an attacker throttled on /unlock could try guesses via /change (still needs correct current_pin, but should still respect rate limit).
extras.py lock_remove with wrong PIN returns 401 but does NOT increment failed_attempts nor trigger the rate limit — same bypass path.

extras.py webauthn_register_options uses upsert=True which will create a settings row without pin_hash if called before setup — could leave the app in an inconsistent state (no PIN but a webauthn credential could be registered).
extras.py summary/month savings_rate is (result/income)*100, which yields >100% possible only if expense<0. But it treats income=0 as 0% (could arguably be null). Minor.
Frontend Radar: initial `loading:false` caused SSR/first-paint crash. Fix keeps loading:true always until effect completes.
Frontend AppLock keypad UX: consider auto-submit and haptic/visual feedback when PIN length reached.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after Radar fix (alerts, month-summary, radar options, simulator, AI analyze, PIN setup/lock-screen/keypad/unlock/remove all verified)

test_credentials: N/A — app has no user auth. Test PINs used: 1234, 5678, both removed at end.
seed_data_creation: None new. Reused DB state from iteration 1. PIN 1234/5678 configured then removed; final GET /api/lock/status returns {configured:false}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_extras.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_extras.xml`. Uses -n 0 to avoid pytest.ini's xdist parallelism (lock tests share DB state). Suite includes an autouse cleanup fixture that removes any stray PIN. If BCB (api.bcb.gov.br) is down, TestRates.test_rates_from_bcb and TestAnalyze.test_analyze_returns_text will skip with 502. Radar frontend bug has been fixed in Relatorios.jsx (initial loading=true + null-guard).
rca of the issue: Radar crash: In Relatorios.jsx `function Radar()`, initial useState hooks set loading=false and rates=null. useEffect runs load() AFTER first render commit; therefore the very first render reached `rates.source` on line 220 while rates was still null → TypeError. Reproduction: navigate to Relatórios → Radar tab (any device). Mitigation: `useState(true)` for loading + `if (!rates) return null;` guard before JSX. Deeper fix: use React 18 `useSuspense`/`use()` or move fetch out to a data-context loader.
